title: Red Aari Embroidered Cotton Suit Set – Anarkali or Straight Kurta with Gujarati Print Mulmul Dupatta
color_custom: Deep red with multicolour aari embroidery
fit: Anarkali: fitted bodice, flared · Straight Kurta: regular straight fit
description:
Raas is named after the joyful circle dance of Gujarat – one suit, two classic cuts. Choose the flared Anarkali to twirl in, or the easy straight kurta.

A deep red cotton suit with bright aari hand embroidery in yellow, orange and green, matching embroidered pants and a mulmul dupatta in a Gujarati-style print with aari work. Same price for both styles.

✦ Choose Your Style
• Anarkali – V-neck with an aari-embroidered yoke, gathered at the high waist into a full flare; embroidered motifs on the body, cuffs and hem
• Straight Kurta – V-neck with an aari-embroidered yoke, straight cut with side slits, embroidered motifs and hem
Both: full sleeves, calf length, 3-piece set (kurta, pants, dupatta). Photos show both – the Anarkali has the gathered flare, the straight kurta falls straight.

✦ The Dupatta
A soft mulmul (cotton muslin) dupatta in the same red, with a Gujarati-style print and colourful aari embroidery – wide borders, floral medallions and a festive pallu that does most of the talking.

✦ Fabric & Craft
Kurta and pants in soft cotton, dupatta in mulmul cotton. The aari embroidery on the kurta, pants and dupatta is done by hand – aari is a fine hooked needle that makes small, even chain stitches, giving the colourful raised look you see up close.

✦ Fit & Size
Sizes XS–3XL, or stitched to your measurements free of charge. Between sizes? Size up, or WhatsApp us your bust and height.

✦ How to Style It
Oxidised silver jhumkas and juttis or kolhapuris for Navratri and garba nights, Diwali puja or a mehndi; the straight kurta also works for festive office days. Abroad, add a black or camel coat over the red for winter festivals and Christmas gatherings.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in our own Jaipur unit
• Free custom fit – send your bust, waist and hip and we stitch it to your measurements at no extra cost
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with live tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

Hand embroidery means tiny variations from piece to piece – that is the mark of handwork. The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Kurta – Anarkali or Straight (cotton, aari hand embroidery)
Dupatta (mulmul cotton, Gujarati print with aari work)
care: Dry clean recommended for the first wash, then gentle hand wash in cold water, inside out. Do not wring or bleach. Dry in shade and iron on the reverse side, avoiding the embroidery.
